title: P15.9-B5.1: /app/workforce + /app/workforce/:id AI Workforce & Agent Detail
description: B5.1 R4 — AgentDetail inbox fail-closed hardening. The inbox read now validates the ENVELOPE before touching messages: null/non-object 200 body or non-array messages → 'malformed' (MALFORMED badge, 'messages withheld, never rendered as empty'); {state:"CORRUPT"} → CORRUPT panel. Any null/primitive/non-object ELEMENT marks the whole inbox malformed — never silently filtered into a false 'No messages'. Only a proven canonical envelope renders messages; per-message, unknown/missing receipt_status → UNVERIFIED badge + body withheld (unified isCorruptMessage predicate preserved: corrupt flag / state=CORRUPT / receipt_status=CORRUPT → CORRUPT badge + withheld body); PENDING/ACKNOWLEDGED render unchanged. New e2e: 7-case detail matrix (null envelope, [null], ["bad"], mixed valid+null, unknown status, missing status, real canonical empty) asserting no false empty, no leaked bodies, no indefinite skeleton. R1–R3 preserved (two-phase identity prefetch, tri-state contract, per-element workforce validation, truthful terminate copy). Proof: tsc+vite PASS; playwright 94/94 full suite on real :8790 — clean.
